name: Audio extractor
tagline: 🔊 Hear what happened. Log the sound, a transcript, and a description to Helix.
description: Pull the audio track from the camera at the moment a person is detected, ask Gemini what it hears, and post three fields to Helix: the kind of sound, a word-for-word transcript of any speech, and a sentence describing what was heard. Because only the audio is sent — no frames — this costs roughly an eighth of what the video analytic costs over the same span. The camera's microphone must be enabled; the step fails with a clear message if it isn't.
summary: Webhook → extract audio → Gemini transcribe → Helix event with Sound + Transcript + Description
